meta.title: Freight Services
meta.description: Power Only, Dry Van, Reefer, Dedicated, Regional, Expedited and Over the Road freight services from KUL Enterprises. Licensed carrier based in Loganville, Georgia, authorized in 48 states.

compare.heading: Find the service that fits your lane
compare.body: If none of them obviously fits, describe the load and we will tell you which one does, including when the answer is that KUL is not the right carrier for it.

specs.heading: In detail

howItMoves.heading: The call, the number, the route, the proof.

steps.name: Enquiry
steps.body: Call dispatch, or send the lane. Six fields: origin, destination, freight type, pickup date, how to reach you, and anything else we should know.

steps.name: Quote
steps.body: A real number, usually the same day. If the lane does not suit us, we say so then.

steps.name: Dispatch
steps.body: You get the route, the timing and the driver assignment before the wheels turn.

steps.name: Delivery
steps.body: Updates on the way, proof on arrival, and dispatch reachable throughout.
